1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 2 isles, 9.0 s demand changes, 58 MJ storage and 0.2 s grid response.
1.natural_language: Retire every coal works while keeping every crew powered. Launch the transition, then share the 100 MW clean grid between the changing island loads. Requests above 100 MW are scaled proportionally. Green supply follows requests with inertia; batteries absorb mismatches. Emptying any battery ends the attempt. Gold is current load; cyan shows the locally forecast load in 1.5 seconds. Drag the green policy cards to set requested power. Inspect and adjust before launch. Live power corrections remain available until a battery empties. CERTIFY NOW commits the current transition. The first empty battery or rejected certification ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
